resolution_notes: Disputed base_url: ORIGINAL confirmed. Verifier A claimed central.sonatype.com internal browse API is the current REST API; official Rest API Guide still documents the public Solr search endpoint at search.maven.org/solrsearch/select (and related Solr query parameters). Verifier B confirmed. Live curl of the original URL returns Solr JSON. Evidence: https://central.sonatype.org/search/rest-api-guide/ and https://search.maven.org/solrsearch/select. Disputed example: ORIGINAL form confirmed as working public API example; response shape matches Solrselect (responseHeader/response/docs). If docs emphasize other endpoints, those are additional/internal browse surfaces—not a replacement that makes the documented search.maven.org Solr API incorrect for this directory entry. Evidence: same docs URL plus live response from the example request.
